context: Asuka lectures on how rules are designed.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: civics lecture; vocabulary (改正/規定/特定/活用/手段) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 規定は、社会を守るために作られます。
lines.en: Provisions are made to protect society.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 改正は、よく行われるんですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 時代に合わせて、改正されます。
lines.en: They're revised to suit the times.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 特定の人だけに、関わる規定もありますか?
lines.en: Are there provisions only for specific people?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 特定の職業向けの規定も、あります。
lines.en: There are provisions for specific occupations too.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 規定を、どう活用するんですか?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 正しい手段で、規定を活用します。
lines.en: By proper means, provisions are utilized.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 改正の手段も、慎重なんですね。
lines.en: The means of revision are careful too.
lines.style: understanding adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
